description: The plot illustrates the comparison of different query selection strategies by showing the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and the MRR@10 score. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)." on a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" on a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The "DPR w/o query" strategy is represented by a solid black line without markers, which remains constant at approximately 34.25 across the entire x-axis. The "DPR w/ gold" strategy is shown as a solid yellow line with circle markers; it starts at an x-value of 1 with a y-value of approximately 33.0, remains flat until x=3, and then rises steadily to end at x=10 with a y-value of approximately 34.7. The "DPR w/ top-1" strategy features a solid green line with circle markers, starting at x=1 and 33.0, rising sharply to approximately 35.0 at x=2, and continuing to increase to a final value of approximately 36.4 at x=10; a corresponding dotted green line without markers remains horizontal at approximately 34.6. The "DPR w/ bottom-1" strategy is depicted by a solid purple line with circle markers, beginning at x=1 and approximately 34.6, peaking at x=3 and approximately 35.2, and then gradually declining to end at x=10 and approximately 34.7; a corresponding dotted purple line without markers remains horizontal at approximately 34.9. The "DPR w/ random" strategy is represented by a solid blue line with circle markers, starting at x=1 and approximately 34.9, rising slightly to approximately 35.1 at x=2, and remaining relatively steady to end at x=10 and approximately 35.2; a corresponding dotted blue line without markers remains horizontal at approximately 35.2. Finally, the "DPR w/ curriculum" strategy is shown as a solid red line with circle markers, starting at x=1 and approximately 35.1 and rising steadily to end at x=10 and approximately 35.8; a corresponding dotted red line without markers remains horizontal at approximately 35.6.
